your_games.title: 🪓 Valheim hotfix 1.0.31 fixes PS5 frame drops and two broken achievements
your_games.body: A day after patch 1.0.30, Iron Gate has made The Artisan and The Master Chef achievements unlockable again, fixed a memory leak in the build menu and fixed choppy, regular frame drops on PS5. The hotfix stays network-compatible with 1.0.30, so crossplay keeps working while consoles catch up, and the studio says it isn't finished adjusting the Forge of Potential yet.

your_games.title: 🐺 The Witcher 3 Remastered patch 5.02 adds 40 cross-platform mods and fixes game-breaking bugs
your_games.body: CD Projekt Red's latest patch, out on all platforms, brings 40 more mods to consoles (with more promised), fixes bugs that could crash the game, send time backwards or leave Geralt bald, and keeps working through the remaster's overly bright or dark lighting and flickering.

your_games.title: 🌱 Nintendo promises a fix for long load times in Pikmin 4's Switch 2 Edition
your_games.body: Nintendo says it is preparing an update for the slow loading when travelling to surface areas, including the Rescue Camp, in Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy. It is also investigating slow launches and Dandori Challenge loads on unstable connections, and suggests a stable network in the meantime.

your_games.title: 🗡️ Phantom Blade Zero's 7GB PS5 update on Saturday adds Combat Assist and cuts stutter
your_games.body: S-Game's update 1.0304629 arrives on 28 November with a new Combat Assist settings section and an option to tame the strong camera assist, lower memory use in cutscenes and snowy areas, smoother boss fights, better lock-on and a long list of combat, quest and progression fixes.

your_games.title: 🎯 Lenny Kravitz brings his 007 First Light pirate king to a free Hitman Elusive Target
your_games.body: IO Interactive's new Elusive Target, The Mutiny, has Kravitz's Bawma guiding Agent 47 round Ambrose Island to take out three rogue lieutenants. It is free in Hitman World of Assassination and its free demo until 24 December, and owners keep the Arcade version afterwards.

your_games.title: 🦑 Splatoon 3 update 12.0.1 fixes Anarchy Battle matchmaking getting stuck
your_games.body: Out today, the small follow-up to last week's big 12.0.0 update fixes Anarchy Battle (Series) matchmaking that sometimes failed to complete. You need it to play online, and local wireless needs everyone on the same version.

your_games.title: 🎮 Absolum is free to try for Switch Online members in Europe until 3 December
your_games.body: Dotemu's roguelike beat 'em up is the latest Nintendo Switch Online Game Trial in Europe, playable in full from today, and the free Switch 2 upgrade pack works during the trial too.

your_games.title: 🛹 EA ends Skate's seasons and battle pass in favour of more regular updates
your_games.body: Skate's fifth and final season ends on 1 December. Full Circle is dropping the skate.Pass by the end of the year, retiring the Tix currency, unlocking some paywalled maps and shipping smaller, more frequent updates, starting with 0.33.1.

your_games.title: 🦙 Palworld and Dune: Awakening get a 10%-off Steam bundle
your_games.body: Pocketpair has paired its creature-catching survival game with Funcom's Arrakis survival game, and Steam's Complete the Set pricing means owners of one get the other at the discount. Palworld's v1.1 Side by Side update is still due this winter, and Dune's free Blood and Ice expansion arrives on 1 December.

industry.title: Rockstar staff vote three to one against union recognition
industry.body: With a 93.2% turnout across Rockstar's UK studios, 75.3% of 1,544 staff voted against recognising the IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union, which would have been the UK games industry's biggest recognised union. The union says it will keep organising but can't re-apply for three years, and the tribunal over 34 sacked staff is still waiting on a judgement.

industry.title: GTA VI nearly doubles UK games retail spending in its launch week
industry.body: NielsenIQ says UK games retail revenue rose 99% week-on-week to £142m from 19 to 21 November. GTA VI made £32m at physical retail despite shipping as a code in a box, the biggest boxed week since Christmas 2018, while PS5 sales rose 46% and Xbox Series X|S 75%.

industry.title: Analysts put GTA VI past 40 million sales but say console supply caps its growth
industry.body: Ampere, Sensor Tower and Enders analysts expect 50 million or more by the end of the year, but warn a quarter of the roughly 137 million current-gen consoles already bought it, so the unconfirmed PC version is the next big growth step.

industry.title: Square Enix credits Switch 2 support for a jump in console game profits
industry.body: President Takashi Kiryu says supporting new hardware, including Switch 2, helped lift HD Games sales from ¥24bn to ¥35.6bn and operating income from ¥5bn to ¥13bn year on year, with Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World next in December.

industry.title: Ubisoft denies teams must justify not using generative AI
industry.body: Responding to yesterday's Vertical Slice report, Ubisoft says it encourages teams to explore where AI is useful but projects are not required to use it, and each team decides whether it fits their game.
